title: Tokens, then polish: make the design tokens, then fix a finished screen with them
agent: claude -p in an empty project outside the repository, with design-system, ui-polish installed
answer:
I've made the design tokens and polished the card. Both are below: first the token report, then the polish pass. --- ## Design system: Invoicing app Path a, from your colour. Archetype: precise-fintech. An invoicing product calls for precise, trustworthy numbers. This report is the whole reply: the files written, the checks run with every result, and the open questions. ### Files - design-tokens.json: W3C design tokens - tokens.css: CSS custom properties, light and dark - design-system-report.md: this report ### Colours kept | Input | Hex | Hue | Placed at | |-------|-----|-----|-----------| | primary | #0d9488 | 175° | primary-700 | Status colours not given, defaults used: success #16a34a (success-700), warning #d97706 (warning-600), danger #dc2626 (danger-500), info #2563eb (info-500). Primary button: white text on your #0d9488 is 3.74:1 (below 4.5:1), so the fill uses primary-800 #0b7067, the nearest darker step of the same hue, where white text is 5.95:1. Your #0d9488 stays unchanged at primary-700 and as --color-brand. Hue check: each input hex is unchanged and every step aims at its exact hue; lightness follows the fixed steps and saturation eases toward the palest and darkest steps, and steps 400 to 700 are never more colourful than your colour. Rounding to hex moves the hue at most 0.1° at steps 300 to 800 and 0.3° at the palest and darkest steps. ### Contrast Text needs 4.5:1; borders of controls and focus rings need 3:1; border-default is for dividers and is not checked. Every text role meets 4.5:1, so it is safe at any size. | Text | On | Light | Dark | Needs | Result | |------|----|-------|------|-------|--------| | text-default | all 4 surfaces | 12.63:1 | 9.77:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | text-muted | all 4 surfaces | 5.72:1 | 5.79:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | text-link | all 4 surfaces | 5.23:1 | 6.30:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | selected-text | all 4 surfaces, selected-bg | 5.23:1 | 6.30:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | text-inverse | surface-inverse | 13.72:1 | 13.72:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | action-primary-text | action-primary-bg, action-primary-bg-hover, action-primary-bg-pressed | 5.95:1 | 5.95:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | success-text | surface-default, success-bg-subtle | 6.50:1 | 7.36:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | success-text-on | success-bg | 6.37:1 | 6.37:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | warning-text | surface-default, warning-bg-subtle | 7.89:1 | 6.77:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | warning-text-on | warning-bg | 4.52:1 | 4.52:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | danger-text | surface-default, danger-bg-subtle | 5.59:1 | 10.36:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | danger-text-on | danger-bg | 4.83:1 | 4.83:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | info-text | surface-default, info-bg-subtle | 6.65:1 | 7.50:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | info-text-on | info-bg | 5.17:1 | 5.17:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | border-strong | surface-default, surface-subtle | 4.43:1 | 4.59:1 | 3:1 | pass | | border-focus | surface-default, surface-subtle | 3.57:1 | 8.84:1 | 3:1 | pass | Light and Dark give the lowest ratio of each role over the surfaces listed; 37 pairs checked in each mode. ### How to use - Load tokens.css before your own styles. - Without a data-theme attribute the page follows the system setting; set data-theme="light" or data-theme="dark" on the html element to force one. - Spacing: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64 px. Type sizes: 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 30 px, body 16 px, line-height 1.5. Weights: 400 and 600. - Controls: 32, 40, 48 px high; every click or tap area at least 44 px. Breakpoints: 640, 768, 1024, 1280 px (copy the numbers into media queries). - Brand colour on at most 10% of a screen: primary action, links, focus ring, selected row. - Font: the system font stack. No font files, imports or links. ### Open questions - Hover and pressed share primary-900, because the filled button sits near the end of its scale; give pressed its own colour if they must differ. --- ## UI polish: Invoice card 17 fixes across Spacing, Typography, Contrast, Hierarchy, States, Layout, Motion and Tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `padding: 13px` on the card is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Spacing**: `margin: 0 0 5px` on the heading is off the scale. Now `margin: 0 0 var(--space-4)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Spacing**: the paragraph's browser default margin (`1em`, 13px) is off the scale. Now `margin: 0 0 var(--space-16)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Spacing**: `padding: 6px 10px` on the buttons is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **Typography**: `font-size: 22px` on the heading is off the scale. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-2xl)` (24px), with `line-height: var(--line-height-heading)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 6. **Typography**: `font-size: 13px` body text is below 16px. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-md)`, with `line-height: var(--line-height-body)` and `max-width: var(--measure)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 7. **Typography**: the buttons used the browser's default ~13.33px size and font. Now `font: inherit; font-size: var(--font-size-md); line-height: var(--line-height-body)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 8. **Typography**: the heading's default bold (700) gave a third weight. Now `font-weight: var(--font-weight-strong)`, and the buttons use the same weight. (R-ui-polish-8, R-ui-polish-20) 9. **Contrast**: `#999999` on `#ffffff` is 2.85:1. Now `var(--color-text-muted)`, 6.52:1. (R-ui-polish-4, R-ui-polish-20) 10. **Contrast**: white on `#0d9488` is 3.74:1. "Pay now" now uses `var(--color-action-primary-bg)` with `var(--color-action-primary-text)`, 5.95:1. Same hue, one step darker. (R-ui-polish-4, R-ui-polish-11, R-ui-polish-21) 11. **Hierarchy**: both buttons were filled, so there were two primary actions. "Pay now" stays filled. "Download PDF" is now secondary: transparent background, `var(--color-action-secondary-text)` text and a `var(--color-action-secondary-border)` border. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-21) 12. **States**: the buttons had no hover, focus or disabled styles. Added hover (`--color-action-primary-bg-hover` on the primary, `--color-selected-bg` on the secondary), a pressed style, `:focus-visible { outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px }` and `:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed }`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 13. **Layout**: the buttons were about 28px tall. Now `min-height: var(--size-target-min); min-width: var(--size-target-min)`. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 14. **Layout**: the two buttons touched each other. Now `.card button + button { margin-left: var(--space-8) }`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 15. **Motion**: added `transition: background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard)` for the hover change, and turned it off under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. (R-ui-polish-9, R-ui-polish-20) 16. **Tokens**: colours `#ffffff`, `#e5e7eb` and `#111827` are now `var(--color-surface-raised)`, `var(--color-border-default)` and `var(--color-text-default)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 17. **Tokens**: `border-radius: 5px` is off the token scale. Now `var(--radius-md)` on the card and `var(--radius-control)` on the buttons. `1px` is now `var(--border-width-hairline)` and `system-ui` is now `var(--font-family-sans)`. (R-ui-polish-20) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Heading | #111827 on #ffffff, 17.74:1 | `--color-text-default` (#212c2b) on `--color-surface-raised` (#ffffff), 14.39:1 | | Due date | #999999 on #ffffff, 2.85:1 | `--color-text-muted` (#4c6260) on `--color-surface-raised` (#ffffff), 6.52:1 | | Pay now | #ffffff on #0d9488, 3.74:1 | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--color-action-primary-bg` (#0b7067), 5.95:1 | | Pay now, hover | none | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--color-action-primary-bg-hover` (#0a423d), 11.29:1 | | Download PDF | #ffffff on #0d9488, 3.74:1 | `--color-action-secondary-text` (#0b7067) on `--color-surface-raised` (#ffffff), 5.95:1 | | Download PDF, hover | none | `--color-action-secondary-text` (#0b7067) on `--color-selected-bg` (#f1fcfb), 5.69:1 | | Secondary border, focus ring (3:1) | none | `--color-action-secondary-border` / `--color-border-focus` (#0d9488) on `--color-surface-raised` (#ffffff), 3.74:1 | Ratios computed with the contrast script. ### Polished code ```html
